  /* 本月问卷统计：按题目展示当月各选项占比条形图 */
  function showQuizStat(){
    var now=new Date(); var y=now.getFullYear(), m=now.getMonth();
    var all=load();
    var recs=[];
    Object.keys(all).forEach(function(d){ var dp=d.split('-'); if(+dp[0]===y && (+dp[1]-1)===m){ if(all[d].quiz) recs.push(all[d]); } });
    var body='';
    if(!recs.length){ body='<div class="hist-section" style="text-align:center;color:#8a90a0">本月还没有问卷记录，先打卡填问卷吧</div>'; }
    else {
      body+='<div class="hs-label" style="margin-bottom:8px">本月共 <b>'+recs.length+'</b> 天填写问卷</div>';
      QUIZ.forEach(function(item){
        var cnt={}; item.opts.forEach(function(o){ cnt[o[0]]=0; });
        recs.forEach(function(r){ var v=r.quiz[item.id]; if(v&&cnt[v]!=null) cnt[v]++; });
        var total=recs.length;
        body+='<div class="qz-stat-q">'+item.q+'</div>';
        item.opts.forEach(function(o){
          var c=cnt[o[0]]; var pct=total?Math.round(c/total*100):0;
          body+='<div class="qz-stat-row"><span class="qz-stat-lbl">'+o[1]+'</span><span class="qz-bar"><span class="qz-bar-fill" style="width:'+pct+'%"></span></span><span class="qz-stat-c">'+c+' · '+pct+'%</span></div>';
        });
      });
    }
    var sm=String(m+1).padStart(2,'0');
    $('quizStatSub').textContent='（'+y+'-'+sm+'）';
    $('quizStatBody').innerHTML=body;
    $('quizStatMask').style.display='flex';
  }

  /* 打卡历史回看：列出全部按日期记录，可按月筛选 + 搜索；支持 JSON 导出/导入（落盘备份，防 localStorage 丢失） */
  var CI_LBL={
    marketState:{A:'A 极佳',B:'B 正常',C:'C 混沌',D:'D 亏钱效应',E:'E 极端风险'},
    excited:{1:'有',0:'无'},
    state:{empty:'空仓',open:'开仓'},
    tradeType:{planned:'计划内',mode:'计划外·符合模式',tilt:'计划外·临时起意'},
    pollution:{self:'A 自己的研究',others:'B 别人告诉',fomo:'C 看别人赚·FOMO',prove:'D 被质疑·想证明',revenge:'E 刚亏·想赚回',miss:'F 错过·想找补',overexcite:'G 兴奋睡不着'},
    checklist:{inscope:'认知内',catalyst:'有催化/产业逻辑',leader:'龙头/辨识度',sustain:'有持续性',buypoint:'买点明确',rr:'盈亏比合理'},
    emptyReason:{foreseen_dd:'预感亏钱效应将至',no_target:'无符合审美的标的',rest_life:'休息/身体/家事',sell_day_rest:'卖出日·强制休息',breaker:'断路器·强制空仓',other:'其他'},
    result:{normal:'正常',big_loss:'大亏',big_win:'大赚'},
    reflResult:{exec:'按计划执行 ✓',part:'部分执行（偏差已记录）',none:'未执行'},
    planHold:{sell:'卖',keep:'持',add:'加',none:'无持仓'},
    planOpen:{0:'没有 → 不开新仓',1:'有新逻辑+催化'},
    planExcited:{1:'有·兴奋到想重仓',0:'无·没感觉'},
    quiz:{exec:{'full':'完全按计划','part':'基本按计划·小偏差','off':'偏离计划','none':'临时起意·没按','nop':'今日无计划(空仓)'},pos:{'ok':'严格按计划','slightly_over':'略超计划','over_heavy':'明显过重·上头','too_light':'明显偏轻·怕了','empty_ok':'空仓按计划'},mood:{'calm':'平静·按计划','anxious_ok':'略焦虑但忍住','fomo':'追涨上头','panic':'恐慌砍仓','miss_ok':'错过也不慌'},effect:{'strong':'强赚钱效应','local':'局部赚钱','weak':'弱/分化','loss':'亏钱扩散'}}
  };
  function ciEsc(s){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;'}[c];}); }
  function ciFmt(v,map){ if(v==null||v==='') return ''; if(map&&map[v]!=null) return map[v]; return v; }
  function ciFmtArr(arr,map){ if(!arr||!arr.length) return ''; return arr.map(function(x){return '<span class="tag">'+ciEsc(ciFmt(x,map))+'</span>';}).join(''); }
  function ciRow(k,v){ if(v==null||v===''||v===false) return ''; return '<div class="hist-rec-row"><div class="hist-rec-k">'+k+'</div><div class="hist-rec-v">'+v+'</div></div>'; }
  function renderCheckinHist(){
    var all=load();
    var dates=Object.keys(all).filter(function(d){return all[d]&&typeof all[d]==='object';}).sort().reverse();
    var months={}; dates.forEach(function(d){ months[d.slice(0,7)]=1; });
    var sel=$('histMonthSel'); var cur=sel.value;
    sel.innerHTML='<option value="">全部月份</option>'+Object.keys(months).sort().reverse().map(function(m){return '<option value="'+m+'">'+m+'</option>';}).join('');
    if(cur) sel.value=cur;
    var q=$('histSearch').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    var list=dates.filter(function(d){
      if(sel.value && d.slice(0,7)!==sel.value) return false;
      if(q){ if(JSON.stringify(all[d]).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0) return false; }
      return true;
    });
    $('histCount').textContent='共 '+list.length+' 条'+(sel.value?'（'+sel.value+'）':'')+(q?' · 含「'+q+'」':'');
    if(!list.length){ $('checkinHistBody').innerHTML='<div class="hist-empty-tip">没有匹配的记录。'+(dates.length?'换个月份或关键词试试。':'先去「今日打卡」记录吧。')+'</div>'; return; }
    var body='';
    list.forEach(function(d){
      var r=all[d];
      var st=r.state==='open'?(sizePct(r.size)>=50?'heavy':'open'):'empty';
      var badge = st==='empty'?'空仓':(st==='open'?'开仓':'重仓/满仓');
      var meta=[];
      if(r.marketState) meta.push(ciFmt(r.marketState,CI_LBL.marketState));
      if(r.excited!=null) meta.push('兴奋:'+ciFmt(r.excited,CI_LBL.excited));
      if(r.size&&st!=='empty') meta.push('仓位:'+r.size+'%');
      var html='';
      if(st!=='empty'){
        html+=ciRow('交易性质',ciFmt(r.tradeType,CI_LBL.tradeType));
        html+=ciRow('来源',ciFmt(r.pollution,CI_LBL.pollution));
        html+=ciRow('机会筛选',ciFmtArr(r.checklist,CI_LBL.checklist));
        html+=ciRow('结果',ciFmt(r.result,CI_LBL.result));
        html+=ciRow('事故代码',ciFmtArr(r.accidents,ACCIDENT_LABEL));
      } else {
        html+=ciRow('空仓原因',ciFmt(r.emptyReason,CI_LBL.emptyReason));
      }
      if(r.reflResult) html+=ciRow('昨日计划反思',ciFmt(r.reflResult,CI_LBL.reflResult)+(r.reflReason?('：'+ciEsc(r.reflReason)):''));
      if(r.summary) html+=ciRow('今日盘面总结',ciEsc(r.summary));
      if(r.plan&&(r.plan.hold||r.plan.open!=null)){
        html+=ciRow('持仓处置',ciFmt(r.plan.hold,CI_LBL.planHold)+(r.plan.holdNote?('：'+ciEsc(r.plan.holdNote)):''));
        html+=ciRow('新机会',ciFmt(r.plan.open,CI_LBL.planOpen));
        if(r.plan.open==1){
          html+=ciRow('计划仓位',r.plan.size?r.plan.size+'%':'');
          html+=ciRow('计划兴奋',ciFmt(r.plan.excited,CI_LBL.planExcited));
          html+=ciRow('开仓理由',ciEsc(r.plan.reason||''));
          html+=ciRow('操作计划',ciEsc(r.plan.action||''));
        }
      }
      if(r.opportunities) html+=ciRow('潜在机会',ciEsc(r.opportunities));
      if(r.quiz){
        var qs=[];
        QUIZ.forEach(function(it){ if(r.quiz[it.id]){ var lv=r.quiz[it.id]; qs.push(it.q+'：'+((CI_LBL.quiz[it.id]&&CI_LBL.quiz[it.id][lv])?CI_LBL.quiz[it.id][lv]:lv)); } });
        if(qs.length) html+=ciRow('自省问卷',qs.join(' ｜ '));
      }
      body+='<div class="hist-record '+st+'"><div class="hist-rec-head" onclick="this.nextElementSibling.classList.toggle(\'on\')"><span class="rd">'+d+'</span><span class="badge '+st+'">'+badge+'</span><span class="meta">'+(meta.join(' · ')||'—')+'</span></div><div class="hist-rec-body">'+html+'</div></div>';
    });
    $('checkinHistBody').innerHTML=body;
  }

  $('histBackupBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
    var all=load(); var blob=new Blob(['﻿'+JSON.stringify(all,null,2)],{type:'application/json;charset=utf-8'});
    var a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download='复盘打卡备份.json';

    alert('已备份全部打卡到「复盘打卡备份.json」（固定文件名，覆盖旧备份）。\n清缓存或换电脑后，点「导入」选这个文件即可恢复。');

  $('histImportFile').addEventListener('change',function(e){
    var f=e.target.files[0]; if(!f) return;
    var fr=new FileReader();
    fr.onload=function(){
      try{
        var imp=JSON.parse(fr.result); var all=load(); var n=0;
        Object.keys(imp).forEach(function(d){ if(imp[d]&&typeof imp[d]==='object'){ all[d]=imp[d]; n++; } });
        save(all);
        ciSyncAll(all);
        alert('已导入 '+n+' 天记录并合并进本机，页面即将刷新以应用。');
        setTimeout(function(){location.reload();},200);
      }catch(err){ alert('导入失败：文件不是有效的打卡 JSON。'); }
    };
    fr.readAsText(f); e.target.value='';
  });
  /* 本周纪律评分：奖励正确行为，而非随机结果 */
  function showWeekScore(){
    var now=new Date(); var wd=now.getDay();
    var mon=new Date(now); mon.setDate(now.getDate()-(wd===0?6:wd-1));
    var all=load();
    var days=[]; for(var i=0;i<7;i++){ var d=new Date(mon); d.setDate(mon.getDate()+i); days.push(ymd(d)); }
    var tradeDays=days.filter(function(k){ return isCountDay(k); });
    var recs=tradeDays.map(function(k){ return {d:k,r:all[k]}; });
    var recorded=recs.filter(function(x){ return x.r; });
    var planned=0, hit=0, tilt=0, mode=0, posOver=0, moodBad=0, polluted=0;
    recorded.forEach(function(x){
      var r=x.r;
      if(r.tradeType==='tilt') tilt++;
      else if(r.tradeType==='mode') mode++;
      else if(r.tradeType==='planned') planned++;
      if(r.quiz&&r.quiz.pos&&(r.quiz.pos==='over_heavy')) posOver++;
      if(r.quiz&&r.quiz.mood&&(r.quiz.mood==='fomo'||r.quiz.mood==='panic')) moodBad++;
      if(r.pollution&&['others','fomo','prove','revenge','miss','overexcite'].indexOf(r.pollution)>=0) polluted++;
      var dp=x.d.split('-'); var yd=new Date(+dp[0],+dp[1]-1,+dp[2]); yd.setDate(yd.getDate()-1); var yk=ymd(yd);
      var pr=all[yk];
      if(pr&&pr.plan&&pr.plan.open){ if(r.state==='open') hit++; }
    });
    var planDays=recorded.filter(function(x){ var dp=x.d.split('-'); var yd=new Date(+dp[0],+dp[1]-1,+dp[2]); yd.setDate(yd.getDate()-1); var pr=all[ymd(yd)]; return pr&&pr.plan&&pr.plan.open; }).length;
    var score=100;
    score -= tilt*15;
    score -= mode*5;
    score -= posOver*10;
    score -= moodBad*10;
    score -= polluted*8;
    score = Math.max(0, score);
    var grade=score>=90?'S · 优秀':(score>=75?'A · 良好':(score>=60?'B · 及格':'C · 需要修复'));
    var sm=String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0');
    var body='';

57.4, 25.0, 7.8]}};
  if(!T || !T.dates || !T.dates.length) return;
  const N = T.dates.length, last = N-1;
  const cur = T.temps[last];
  /* 冷→暖光谱取色（与温度条渐变一致） */
  function tcolor(v){
    const stops=[[0,[37,99,235]],[25,[6,182,212]],[50,[234,179,8]],[75,[249,115,22]],[100,[220,38,38]]];
    v=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,v));
    for(let i=0;i<stops.length-1;i++){
      const [p0,c0]=stops[i],[p1,c1]=stops[i+1];
      if(v>=p0&&v<=p1){
        const r=(v-p0)/(p1-p0||1);
        return 'rgb('+c0.map((c,j)=>Math.round(c+(c1[j]-c)*r)).join(',')+')';
      }
    }
    return 'rgb(220,38,38)';
  }
  /* 当前温度在全部历史中的分位（"今天比历史上多少比例的日子更热"） */
  const valid = T.temps.filter(v=>v!=null);
  const below = valid.filter(v=>v<cur).length;
  const pct = valid.length>1 ? Math.round(below/(valid.length-1)*100) : 50;

  const dEl=document.getElementById('tmpDate');
  if(dEl) dEl.textContent = T.dates[last] + ' 收盘';
  const nEl=document.getElementById('tmpNum');
  if(nEl){ nEl.innerHTML = (cur==null?'—':cur.toFixed(1))+'<span class="tmp-unit">°</span>';
           nEl.style.color = tcolor(cur==null?50:cur); }
  const mEl=document.getElementById('tmpMark');
  if(mEl) mEl.style.left = (cur==null?50:cur)+'%';
  const rEl=document.getElementById('tmpRank');
  if(rEl) rEl.innerHTML = '高于历史 <b style="color:var(--ink)">'+pct+'%</b> 的交易日<br>'
                        + '<span style="opacity:.8">统计区间 '+T.dates[0]+' 起共 '+valid.length+' 天</span>';

  /* 六分项 */
  const pBox=document.getElementById('tmpParts');
  if(pBox && T.parts){
    pBox.innerHTML = T.keys.map(k=>{
      const arr=T.parts[k], v=arr[last];
      if(v==null) return '';
      return '<div class="tmp-part"><div class="pk"><span>'+k+'</span>'
           + '<span class="pv">'+v.toFixed(0)+'</span></div>'
           + '<div class="pt"><span class="pf" style="width:'+v+'%;background:'+tcolor(v)+'"></span></div></div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  /* 历史曲线 */
  let chart=null;
  async function drawTemp(n){
    if(typeof ensureChart!=='function') return;
    let C; try{ C=await ensureChart(); }catch(e){ return; }
    const s = n>0 ? Math.max(0,N-n) : 0;
    const labels=T.dates.slice(s), data=T.temps.slice(s);
    const ctx=document.getElementById('cTemp');
    if(!ctx) return;
    if(chart) chart.destroy();
    chart=new C(ctx,{type:'line',
      data:{labels:labels,datasets:[{
        label:'情绪温度', data:data, borderColor:'#e0820a', borderWidth:2,
        pointRadius:0, pointHoverRadius:4, tension:.28, fill:true,
        segment:{}, backgroundColor:(c)=>{
          const a=c.chart.ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,c.chart.height||300);
          a.addColorStop(0,'rgba(220,38,38,.18)');
          a.addColorStop(.5,'rgba(234,179,8,.10)');
          a.addColorStop(1,'rgba(37,99,235,.06)');
          return a;
        }}]},
      options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,
        interaction:{mode:'index',intersect:false},
        plugins:{legend:{display:false},
          tooltip:{callbacks:{label:c=>' 温度 '+(c.parsed.y==null?'—':c.parsed.y.toFixed(1))}}},
        scales:{
          y:{min:0,max:100,grid:{color:'#f0f1f4'},ticks:{color:'#9aa0ad',stepSize:25}},
          x:{grid:{display:false},ticks:{color:'#9aa0ad',maxTicksLimit:12,autoSkip:true}}
        }}});
  }
  const tb=document.getElementById('tmpTb');
  if(tb) tb.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>{
    b.onclick=()=>{ tb.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on'));
                    b.classList.add('on'); drawTemp(+b.dataset.n); };
  });
  drawTemp(60);
})();
</script>
